repository.name: @webex/plugin-logger
repository.purpose: Logger plugin for the Cisco Webex JS SDK. It replaces the minimal webex-core logger with leveled console output, redaction of authorization keys, email addresses, and MTID values, and in-memory log buffers that internal-plugin-support formats and uploads.

plugin-logger-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing the package registers Logger as the webex 'logger' plugin with replace: true and merges src/config.js into webex config. The barrel exports the Logger constructor as default and the named levels array.

log-buffer-format.summary: In-memory buffer entries and the newline-joined string returned by formatLogs(). Each entry is an array of group indent, ISO-8601 timestamp, client name, then stringified arguments. formatLogs() joins entries with newlines, so Array#toString joins fields with commas. Consumed by @webex/internal-plugin-support for log upload.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Host plugin contract consumed by this module. WebexPlugin.extend supplies config, session state, and the webex reference. registerPlugin with replace: true overwrites the fallback logger registered by webex-core src/plugins/logger.js. The developer feature toggle 'log-level' is read through webex.internal.device when present.

webex-common-js-api.summary: Consumed exports inBrowser and patterns (containsEmails, containsMTID). Owned and specified by @webex/common.

lodash.summary: Runtime dependency. src/logger.js imports cloneDeep, has, isArray, isObject, and isString.

module_docs_decision.reason: Single module rooted at src/ with no existing module-local docs folder. The default source-local route src/docs/README.md is unambiguous. test:style runs eslint ./src/**/*.* and build:src processes -js -ts only, so Markdown under src/docs/ does not enter the lint or build output.
